biography.value:
Description

Male doll given life by the mechanical genius, Luca. She uses Calca and his counterpart, Brina, to assist her in battle and in airship repairs.

Defense

AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+2 dex, +6 natural, +1 size)

hp 63 [91] (7d10+21)

mp 21

Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +6

Defensive Abilities Hardness 5, Living-like; Immune construct traits, blind, curse, petrification, silence; Resist fire 10, ice 10, wind 10, earth 10, lightning 10, water 10;

Offense

Speed 20 ft.

Melee Slam +8 (1d4)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Abilities Doublecast, Jive

Spells Known (FC CL 4th, Concentration +7)

At will - Elemental Orb, Detect Magic, Message, Read Magic

1st (DC 14) - Fire, Thunder (DC 15), Water

2nd (DC 15) - Fire II, Thunder II (DC 16), Water II

3rd (DC 16) - Fire III, Thunder III (DC 17), Water III

4th (DC 17) - Fire IV, Thunder IV (DC 18), Water IV

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 15, Con -, Int 17, Wis 13, Cha 16

Base Atk +7; CMB +7; CMD 20

Feats Combat Casting, Elemental Focus (Lightning), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

Skills Knowledge (Engineering) +10, Perception +8, Sense Motive +8, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +13

description.value: Apply hardness 5.

1/day, Calca can cast two spells using one standard action. Both of the spells must have the same standard action casting time. The Calca can make any decisions concerning the spells independently of each other. These spells are cast simultaneously and must both be stated before any effects occur. A Calca receives a +4 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance with these two spells.

effect: Declare two standard-action spells before resolving either; pay normal costs, separate choices/targets. Both gain +4 on caster-level checks against SR.

description.value: Once every 1d2+1 rounds, Calca can cast one single Blue Mage spell randomly up to 4th level spell. Roll a 1d4, 1 for 1st lvl spells (DC 14), 2 for 2nd lvl spells (DC 15), 3 for 3rd lvl spells (DC 16), and 4 for 4th lvl spells (DC 17) then decide on a dice to roll for each spell list.

effect: Roll [[1d4]] for level, then use that level's table. Choose targets after the random result. No spell is added to the ordinary spellbook.

description.value: Calca gains the benefit of extra hit points from Charisma instead of size due to being a construct which means he can also be healed by normal means. He also gain feats and skills due to having an Intelligence. His saves are also consider Good unlike most constructs.

effect: Normal healing works. Charisma grants 21 HP instead of size HP. Intelligent construct with good base saves.
